title: A health endpoint for the load balancer
prompt:
The load balancer needs a health check. In server/health.go implement `HealthHandler(version string, ready func()
error) http.Handler`: `GET /healthz` answers 200 with JSON `{"status":"ok","version":"<version>"}` and
`Content-Type: application/json` when `ready()` returns nil, and 503 with `{"status":"unavailable","error":"<msg>"}`
otherwise. Other methods get 405 with an `Allow: GET` header. Any other path is 404.
